description: Served with the 75th FIS Bangor Air Defense Sector at Dow AFB Maine by June 1960; loaned to the Oregon ANG 142nd Wing at Portland IAP in 1981
Served with the 480th TFS 366th TFW at Da Nang Air Base South Vietnam wearing markings CV 37 679; struck off charge at Tinker AFB Oklahoma; loaned to the Oregon ANG 142nd Wing by February 1993
Carried on the NMUSAF Aircraft on Loan by Location list to OR ANG Portland 142 FW/AMXS; serial falls inside the FY1976 F-15A block; presence not independently confirmed since that list was compiled
